profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Lead Engineer / Architect - Node Controller Product Tech Lead / Creator
profile.summary: When your work is your hobby you never work a day of your life.  Always tinkering and coming up with new things in software and underlying hardware.  Many times they become real products doing some really cool things -- things that stop people in their tracks to investigate, ask questions, and become quite intrigued.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Lead Engineer / Architect - Node Controller Product Tech Lead / Creator
positions.description: A more rigorous process is required to earn this title at Rockwell Automation through customer recommendations (ARUP Lab, Kuka Systems, Johnson and Johnson, and TWDC), internal recommendations, creation of a mainstream product (the MagneMotion Node Controller with thousands out there), patents, trade secrets etc.  Only 100 or so folks earned this in last 20 years and Rockwell has some 30,000 employees -- this is more of an Engineering Fellow type position even though it is titled Principal.  Very happy to be selected by my peers for this.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: See Rockwell Automation's Independent Cart Technology area https://www.rockwellautomation.com/en-us/products/hardware/independent-cart-technology.html or search for MagneMotion / Rockwell Independent Cart on YouTube! https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=magnemotion Developed a vast amount of the control software involved in what you see.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Specializing in wide coverage outdoor WIFI mesh networks for large events and permanent fixed WIFI networks using rugged embedded linux gear.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Professional consulting specializing in bringing enterprise class Linux servers, software, and networking to small businesses.  Custom Linux Kernel work, embedded device development.

positions.title: Pyrotechnician Crew
positions.description: Seasonal help working with licensed pyrotechnicians putting together fireworks shows from high school graduations and weddings to shows as large as the Boston Esplinade fireworks.

volunteerExperiences.description: For several years have provided a large temporary outdoor wireless network along a 3 mile stretch of the Charles River in Cambridge, MA for the Race Committee behind the worlds largest 2 day Regatta the Head Of The Charles Regatta. The Race Committee uses the network to register thousands of athletes, provide race results, and support the hundreds of people / thousands of volunteers behind this event that attracts over 500,000 spectators every year in October. The challenge is the shear volume of people who overwhelm the traditional cellular network. An Airmax based backhaul network plus over 30 ground location wifi stations provide the critical infrastructure needed so this world class race can be executed without a hitch.  High school rowers to elite olympic athletes are participants in this event that attracts competitors world wide.

patents.title: System and Method for Mover Self-Navigation in an Independent Cart System
patents.description: A system for controlling movers in a linear drive system includes a plurality of movers and a track providing segments along which the movers may travel and holding driver coils and a segment controller controlling the driver coils. Some of the segments having switches forming branches between segments. A central controller communicates operates with the segment controllers to route the movers along the track by distributing routing decisions for a given mover to a segment controller for a track on which a given mover is currently traveling.

patents.title: System and method for controlling direction of a vehicle in an independent cart system
patents.description: A system for selecting one of multiple paths in a linear drive system includes track segments having a first drive member and at least one mover having a second drive member for the linear drive system. Each mover includes a drive surface oriented toward the track segment when the at least one mover is driven along the track. Each mover also includes a first channel and a second channel extending along the drive surface. A switch track segment includes a first path and a second path along which the at least one mover may travel, at least one first pin positioned along the first path, and at least one second pin positioned along the second path. The first and second pins are extendable to engage the first and second channels of the at least one mover to direct the mover along either the first path or the second path, respectively.
